name: Behala Club Sarbojanin Durgotsav Committee
description:
Behala Club Durga Puja entered its 81st year in 2025. This one of the most popular puja mandap in South Kolkata has once again won the hearts of the visitors.

This year's theme is 'Monchash'. The magical touch of artist Krishanu Pal has given the mandap a unique look. Through the idea of ​​'Monchash', the artist has highlighted the eternal 'Adda' culture of Bengalis. How important it is to nourish the mind or cultivate the mind in a busy life has been beautifully portrayed through this theme. The use of earthenware in the interior decoration of the mandap and the peaceful atmosphere have added a different dimension. Especially to protect the artwork from the rain, a completely indoor or roofed mandap has been created this time, which has given comfort to the visitors. The gentle form of the idol and the aesthetics of the mandap are truly admirable.

This 81-year-old traditional puja Successful again in their creativity and social message.

name: Behala Nutan Dal
description:
This year’s grand theme is “Shibani Dham” 🛕✨ – recreating the majestic Rajprasad inspired by Bundelkhand’s royal heritage and devotion to Lord Shiva. The story of Raja Rajkishore and Rai Kumari comes alive through this magnificent pandal, blending history, art, faith, and culture beautifully.

From the moment you walk through the mesmerising passageway, covered in intricate murals and glowing lights, you feel transported into a palace courtyard. The pandal’s detailing is breathtaking – every wall, arch, and carving has been recreated with perfection 🛕🌸.

At the centre stands a divine Lord Shiva statue 🕉️🛕, brought to life with magical lighting effects – calm, powerful, and spiritually uplifting. The idol of Maa Durga 🪔🙏🐅 radiates elegance, with her lions 🐅🐅 adding to the aura of strength and protection. The entire setup creates a serene yet majestic ambience that leaves you awestruck.

name: Behala 29th Pally Club
description:
Behala 29 Pally in Kolkata (PIN: 700038) is a well-known neighborhood, particularly recognized for its vibrant Durga Puja celebrations and strong community spirit. Located in the southern part of the city, Behala is a historically rich and culturally significant area with a blend of old-world charm and modern developments.

One of the key highlights of Behala 29 Pally is its Durga Puja, which draws large crowds every year due to its creative themes, elaborate pandals, and artistic idol decorations. The club organizing the puja is known for bringing in innovative ideas, making it one of the must-visit pujas in South Kolkata. The atmosphere during the festival is electric, with cultural programs, lighting decorations, and food stalls adding to the festive fervor.

Apart from its puja celebrations, Behala 29 Pally is a well-connected residential locality. It has easy access to key places like Taratala, Thakurpukur, and New Alipore via Diamond Harbour Road. The area is served by multiple bus routes, auto-rickshaws, and is in proximity to the upcoming metro expansion, which will further improve connectivity. The nearby Behala Chowrasta and Sakherbazar markets provide daily essentials, making life convenient for residents.

Educational institutions like M. P. Birla Foundation Higher Secondary School and various local colleges add to the locality’s importance. Additionally, healthcare facilities such as Vidyasagar State General Hospital and private nursing homes ensure residents have access to quality medical care.

Over the years, Behala 29 Pally has seen infrastructural improvements, with better roads, drainage systems, and new residential complexes coming up. However, like many parts of Kolkata, occasional waterlogging and traffic congestion remain concerns, especially during monsoons.

Overall, Behala 29 Pally is a lively and culturally rich locality, ideal for families looking for a mix of tradition and modern living. The strong sense of community, along with its well-rounded amenities, makes it one of the sought-after neighborhoods in South Kolkata.

name: Barisha Club Puja Ground and Community Hall
description:
A Hub of Culture and Celebration in Kolkata
Barisha Club is undoubtedly one of the most prominent and celebrated landmarks in Kolkata, specifically in the Behala area. It is a true hub of art and culture that attracts thousands of visitors from across West Bengal every year during Durga Puja. The club is famous for its innovative themes, breathtaking artistic installations, and deep cultural resonance, making it an absolute must-visit destination for pandal hoppers.
However, the club's contribution extends far beyond just the four days of Puja. They are extremely active culturally, organizing vibrant events like the traditional Poush Mela and various post-puja award functions that keep the local community engaged throughout the year.
The ground itself is spacious, accessible, and well-maintained, making it an excellent venue for social gatherings. It is frequently available for booking for wedding reception ceremonies, offering a large open space that is often hard to find in the city. Whether you are visiting for the spectacular festivals or attending a family function, Barisha Club offers a fantastic atmosphere. Highly recommended!

name: Diamond park lake Cricket And Football Ground
description:
Diamond Park Lake Cricket Academy holds a special place in my heart—I spent countless afternoons here after tuition during my childhood, playing with friends and learning life beyond textbooks. Even today, the field buzzes with energy as kids still come here to play cricket, football, and run around freely.

This isn’t just a playground—it’s a hub of activity and learning. From karate and dance classes to community events, there's always something happening. The open space, greenery, and safe environment make it perfect for children and families alike.

One of the most heartwarming parts is how the ground transforms during Durga Puja—the entire area lights up with cultural programs, music, and food stalls. It’s where nostalgia meets celebration.
Maintained decently well by the local committee, this spot continues to be a reliable space for recreation, bonding, and tradition. Whether you’re here to play, learn, or just enjoy an evening walk, the field welcomes all.

If you’re in Diamond Park or near Joka Metro, do stop by this ground. You might just relive a bit of your own childhood—or witness someone else creating theirs.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ A playground that raised a generation!

name: Naktala Udayan Sangha
description:
I recently visited Naktala Udayan Sangha during Durga Puja, and it was an absolutely grand and memorable experience for me. From the moment I arrived, I was amazed by the massive theme-based pandal, stunning lighting, and creative artistic presentation, which instantly created a festive and energetic atmosphere.

The idol of Goddess Durga was beautifully crafted, with intricate detailing and a majestic presence that truly stood out. I spent quite some time admiring the theme work and the overall concept, which reflected both innovation and deep-rooted tradition. The sound of dhak beats, devotional chants, and the excitement of the crowd made the entire place feel alive and immersive.

Despite the heavy crowd, the arrangements were quite organized, and I could move through the pandal comfortably. Visiting Naktala Udayan Sangha Durga Puja gave me a strong sense of cultural pride and festive joy — it was definitely one of the highlight pandals during my Durga Puja journey across Kolkata.
